formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 → (∀ (x3 : Fin (10 : ℕ)), ∃ (x4 : Fin (10 : ℕ) → Bool) (x5 : Fin (10 : ℕ) → Bool), (∀ (x6 : Fin (10 : ℕ)), x6 ≠ x3 → x4 x6 = x5 x6) ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (10 : ℕ) x1 x4 ≠ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (10 : ℕ) x1 x5) → ∃ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x4 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (10 : ℕ) x4 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (10 : ℕ) x1 ∧ x4.size ≤ x1.size ∧ (x4.output ≤ (10 : ℕ) + x4.size ∧ ∀ x5 ∈ x4.gates, ∀ x7 ∈ x5.inputs, x7 ≤ (10 : ℕ) + x4.size) ∧ (∀ x5 < (10 : ℕ) + x4.size, x5 ∈ x4.output :: List.flatMap PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate.inputs x4.gates) ∧ (9 : ℕ) + (List.filter (fun (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => x5.op.eval [Bool.false] && !x5.op.eval [Bool.true]) x4.gates).length + ∑ x5 ∈ Finset.range ((10 : ℕ) + x4.size), (List.count x5 (x4.output :: List.flatMap PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate.inputs x4.gates) - (1 : ℕ)) ≤ x4.size
plain_statement: Every AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit on 10 inputs whose function depends on each input has an equivalent one with no more gates that reads no wire past one beyond its last, uses every wire as the output or as a read, and has 9 plus its NOT gates plus its reads beyond one per wire at most its number of gates.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate OR(x_0, x_3) computes its edge function
